country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Zero Four, Montrose datacentre opportunity site
developer: Scottish Enterprise / Host in Scotland opportunity site
notes: Zero Four at Montrose was identified in Scottish Enterprise / Host in Scotland material as a high-potential datacentre site; no named developer, planning application or active build found - opportunity site only.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Killellan AI Growth Zone / Sovereign AI Cloud
notes: 184-acre green digital campus at Killellan Farm/Toward, Cowal Peninsula near Dunoon; Argyll Data Development partnered with SambaNova (Oct 2025) for UK's first renewable-powered sovereign AI inference cloud; DCD earlier reported initial 100-600MW capacity; Herald (2026) reports project 'stalled if not halted' citing grid connection delays; no planning application confirmed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Pulsant Edinburgh South Gyle SC-1
notes: Operational; Pulsant describes SC-1 at South Gyle as Scotland's most connected data centre with 22+ on-site carriers; GBP500k upgrade programme across three Edinburgh sites completed 2025.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: iomart Edinburgh data centre
notes: Operational regional colocation/managed-hosting facility in Edinburgh; iomart official site lists Edinburgh among its UK data centre locations; capacity not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: South Gyle / Edinburgh Green Campus (former RBS HQ)
developer: Shelborn Drummond Ltd / Shelborn Asset Management
notes: Planning permission in principle for ~213MW AI data centre at 1 Redheughs Avenue, South Gyle (former RBS HQ site, demolished 2022) rejected unanimously by City of Edinburgh Council on 4/9 Feb 2026; developer appealed (DPEA ref PPA-230-2794); Scottish Government planning reporter halted appeal pending full EIA (Aug 2026).

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Wester Hermiston Data Centre Campus
notes: Apatura public consultation page states a proposed 200MW AI data centre campus at Wester Hermiston, across the A71 from Heriot-Watt University, City of Edinburgh; EIA screening/PAN references 25/02924/SCR and 25/03978 per ERCS.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: CX Technology Campus / Chapelcross AI data centre campus
developer: CX Power (strategic developer) with Nuclear Decommissioning Authority
notes: NDA and CX Power announced strategic partnership (Nov 2025) to deliver the Chapelcross green energy hub masterplan including a potential 1GW zero-carbon data centre campus with water-neutral advanced cooling; public consultation held in Annan; Dumfries and Galloway Council issued planning guidance via LDP2 Chapelcross Development Framework; planning permission in principle targeted.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Eastriggs AI Growth Zone candidate site
notes: Council commissioned FarrPoint assessment of an AI Growth Zone candidate site at Eastriggs for data centre suitability and submitted an expression of interest; no operator or capacity published.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Brightsolid Dundee Data Centre
notes: Operational Tier III (Uptime accredited) data centre at Gateway House, Luna Place, Dundee Technology Park; Brightsolid HQ; official site confirms colocation in Aberdeen and Dundee.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Rufus Data Centre Campus (near Hurlford)
notes: ILI Group proposes an AI-focused hyperscale data centre campus near Hurlford, Kilmarnock (East Ayrshire) as part of The Stoics network; ILI targets 540MW, campaigners cite ~530MW on ~150 hectares; Construction Index lists planning lead for data centre complex with data halls, substation, road access; major planning application in process.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Apatura Ochiltree / Creoch data centre
notes: Apatura filed for EIA screening opinion (PAN) for a ~200MW data centre on 24.5 hectares south of Creoch Farm near Ochiltree, south of Cumnock, East Ayrshire; pre-application/planning stage.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Apatura Westerhill AI Energy Campus
notes: Apatura consultation site describes a 300MW AI Energy Campus at Westerhill Regeneration Area, Bishopbriggs, East Dunbartonshire; Scottish Government DPEA case 127137 records the proposed data centre campus; EIA/pre-planning stage.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Cockenzie former coal store hyperscale data centre
developer: Sustainable Development Capital LLP (SDCL) with East Lothian Council
notes: East Lothian Council selected SDCL (Oct 2025) as preferred supplier after tender for a hyperscale data centre on the former Cockenzie Power Station coal store site (~70 acres, adjacent to approved BESS); JV agreement progressing per council update (Jul 2026); not yet in planning - announced/planned stage; hyperscale scale, MW not disclosed.

name: Apatura Larbert Data Centre Campus
notes: Apatura submitted plans to Falkirk Council for a ~GBP1bn 300MW hyperscale AI data centre on ~55 acres beside Glenbervie Business Park, Bellsdyke Road, Larbert (proposal submitted and validated May 2025); >1,100 public objections; power secured for Oct 2028; Apatura in exclusivity talks with US operator.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: ILI Cato hyperscale data centre (Auchtertool)
notes: ILI Group submitted planning permission in principle application to Fife Council for Cato, a ~GBP5bn 600MW hyperscale data centre on farmland near Auchtertool (25-60 ha, up to seven buildings and on-site substation); flagship of The Stoics network; local opposition reported.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: DataVita DV2 Glasgow city centre data centre
notes: Operational Tier III city-centre data centre at 177 Bothwell Street, Glasgow (DV2); 130 racks, 1MW power available; opened as Scotland's first metro data centre (2016 campus history); DataVita also operates Lanarkshire DV1 (12MW, outside this division).

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: MeyGen ocean-powered data centre scheme (Caithness)
notes: Invest Highland lists a MeyGen ocean-power-linked data centre development scheme on 20+ ha in Caithness (Highland council area), promoted by SIMEC Atlantis Energy, status greenfield/short-term; early developer announcement only - no planning application or MW verified.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Former IBM Site Spango Valley data centre and BESS (Greenock)
notes: Slate Island Developments is preparing a planning application for a data centre plus 99MW BESS at the former IBM factory site, Spango Valley, Inverkip Road, Greenock (Inverclyde); public consultation held Mar 2026; two buildings of 34,500 sqm and 40,000 sqm; DC IT capacity not disclosed; PAN submitted to Inverclyde Council.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Midlothian AI Data Centre Campus (Apatura)
notes: Public reporting (Aug 2025) says consultation was to begin for an Apatura AI data centre campus in Midlothian / Edinburgh Green Belt; full project details, site and capacity not confirmed in public sources; no planning application verified - announced stage.

name: AI Pathfinder North Ayrshire i3 (Irvine)
notes: Announced Sep 2025: GBP15bn AI infrastructure project at the i3 strategic site, Irvine, with 1GW initial capacity (up to 1.5GW) and 6,400 GPUs in first phase; Bloomberg investigation (Jul 2026) reports project troubles - land marketing/sale sign in May 2026 and no planning application or PAN lodged; treated as announced/unconfirmed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Hunterston Data Centre Campus
developer: Eneus Energy; Revera Energy; Hunterston Estate
notes: Early-stage proposed data centre campus at Hunterston Estate, north of West Kilbride next to Hunterston Power Station, North Ayrshire; Eneus Energy advancing via environmental assessment and public consultation; EIA scoping submitted per APRS; capacity not disclosed.
